Recommendation:
That the implementation of a Sustainable Design Standard as the framework for guiding the planning, design and construction of new buildings, major retrofits and individual asset lifecycle renewals for Town-owned buildings be endorsed;
That the Hybrid Pathway as the Town's preferred approach for reducing greenhouse gas emissions while balancing financial responsibility and long-term asset management objectives be approved; and
That staff be directed to monitor implementation outcomes and report back to Council in one year and undertake a comprehensive review every five years starting in 2030.
